name: Inpweb Ad Spaces – Sell Ads, Banner Manager & Website Monetization
author: Inp-web

sections.description:
Tired of low payouts from traditional ad networks? Take full control of your website’s advertising revenue.

Inpweb Ad Spaces is the ultimate ad manager and banner management tool for WordPress. Designed for website owners, bloggers, and entrepreneurs who want to monetize their traffic by selling advertising space directly to sponsors and keeping 100% of the profits—no middlemen, no complicated setups.

Whether you want to negotiate manual ad placements via WhatsApp or build a fully automated, hands-off monetization machine, this plugin adapts perfectly to your workflow. Insert elegant, high-conversion banner ads anywhere on your site using simple shortcodes or ad widgets.

🚀 Lite Version Features (Free & Powerful)

  • Professional Ad Manager Dashboard: A clean, modern interface to easily set up your advertising rates, ad zones, and banners.
  • Smart Shortcode System: Place your ad slots anywhere (headers, sidebars, within content) with precision using [inpweb_espacio tipo="lateral" id="L1"].
  • Direct WhatsApp Sales: Potential advertisers can click on an empty banner space and instantly connect with you via WhatsApp with a pre-filled, ready-to-buy message.
  • Responsive Banner Design: Pre-styled, high-end ad boxes that automatically adapt to your WordPress theme and look great on mobile devices.
  • Manual Expiry Control: Easily toggle active sponsors on or off, keeping your advertising inventory organized.

💎 Pro Features (Automate & Scale Your Revenue)

  • Stripe Payment Automation: Allow advertisers to upload their banners, pay, and reserve ad spaces 24/7. Funds go straight to your bank account while you sleep.
  • AI Anti-Competitor Filter (Exclusive): Powered by Google Gemini, the system analyzes uploaded banners and automatically blocks your direct competitors from advertising on your website.
  • Advanced Ad Analytics: Track real-time impressions, clicks, and CTR for every banner. Export professional Excel reports to prove ROI to your sponsors.
  • High-Impact Formats: Unlock premium advertising placements like Full-Width banners and sticky ads for maximum visibility and higher pricing.

Upgrade to the PRO version at Inp-web.com to maximize your digital productivity and advertising sales.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the inpweb-ad-spaces folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in your WordPress admin area.
  3. Navigate to the Ad Spaces menu in your dashboard to set up your ad zones and pricing.
  4. If using the Free version, ensure your WhatsApp number is correctly formatted in the Settings panel.
  5. Copy and paste your shortcodes into pages, posts, or widgets to start selling ads immediately!
sections.faq:
Is this ad manager compatible with my theme?

Absolutely! We built Inpweb Ad Spaces using clean, modern CSS. The ad slots and banners inherit your site’s font styles while maintaining a premium, high-converting layout that looks native to your design.

How does the Google Gemini AI Filter work?

This is a game-changer for brand protection. In the PRO version, you define your business niche. If a competitor tries to buy an ad space to “steal” your traffic, the AI analyzes the banner text/link and blocks the transaction automatically.

Do I need a Stripe account to sell ads?

Only if you want to use the automated self-service payment gateway (PRO feature). For the Free version, all you need is a WhatsApp number to receive inquiries and close advertising deals manually.

Can I provide performance reports to my advertisers?

Yes. The PRO version includes an analytics tracking engine. You can generate and export professional Excel reports showing exactly how many impressions and clicks their banner ads received, ensuring long-term renewals.

Why choose Inpweb Ad Spaces over other banner plugins?

Because we focus on Conversion and Simplicity. Most advertising plugins are bloated and slow down your site. Inpweb Ad Spaces is an ad manager built by developers who understand that an elegant dashboard, lightweight code, and a frictionless checkout process are what actually generate ad sales.
